THE LITTLE LANTERN FOX

CONTENTS

  I. The Dark Wood
  II. The Lantern

CHAPTER I. THE DARK WOOD

Once upon a time a small fox lived at the edge of a dark wood. Every
night she was afraid of the dark, and she hid under a fern.

One evening a firefly said, "Why do you hide? I will lend you my
light." The fox was _very_ surprised.

CHAPTER II. THE LANTERN

So the fox carried a tiny lantern all night, and she was not afraid
any more. The wood did not seem so dark. She and the firefly became
friends.
